title: Over 4,800 typhoon-hit Bohol families get aid from NHA

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Nearly five years after Super Typhoon Odette (international name: Rai) devastated Bohol, thousands of affected families in Catigbian town finally received financial assistance from the government. The National Housing Authority (NHA) distributed P48.84 million in financial assistance to 4,884 families affected by Odette during a “Handog ng Pangulo” activity at the Carlos P. Garcia Park at the Bohol Provincial Capitol Complex on Monday, Sept. 14, 2026. Each qualified beneficiary received P10,000 under the NHA’s Emergency Housing Assistance Program (Ehap), which provides financial support to families whose houses were damaged or destroyed by disasters.
